༄༅/ /yang dag me dgu'i rdul tshon la brten pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod byed tshul ngag 'don gyi tho bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru ā nan+da pu ṇ+ya kīr

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /yang dag me dgu'i rdul tshon la brten pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod byed tshul ngag 'don gyi tho bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ā nan+da pu ṇ+ya kīrti dh+wa dza shrī bha drā ya/ dpal yang dag par sbyor ba zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga slob ma dbang bskur tshul sogs/ sa lo'i gsung rtsom thor bu rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa'i yig cha rgyas pa zhig grub mod na'ang / rdul tshon la brten pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang / bdag 'jug len tshul sogs don tshang zhing / snyoms chung dpe sgrub sla ba'i phyir tho tsam bkod pa ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma phur pa bzhin la/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i tshab tu/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa dang / zhes 'don pa sgyur/ kī la ya'i tshab tu/ ru lu brjod/ gnas yo byin rlabs phur pa bzhin/ /rnga bying dbab rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar la/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ bzlas pa bsdu ba'i bar/ sgrub thabs rim pa gsal ba bzhin byas rjes/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ de dur khrod brgyad la༞ de gzhal yas khang la༞ de lha mo brgyad la༞ de gtso bo yab yum la thim/ zhes dkyil 'khor bsdus la sa lha'i tshom bu la dmigs te/ pa pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la/ zhes pa nas/ gser gyi sa gzhir gyur zhes pa'i bar phur pa bzhin la/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i tshab tu he ru ka brjod/ sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin no/ /lha sta gon gyi maṇ+ḍal tshom bu la dmigs nas/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tās sbyangs/ oṃ dharmā dhā tu sogs nas/ gdan bskyed pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar byas la/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du/ dbus su hūm̐/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du/ gaṃ tsaṃ praṃ baṃ/ paṃ ghaṃ shaṃ tsaṃ/ sa bon de rnams las 'od 'phros 'dus/

don gnyis byas yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su dpal chen khro bo'i rgyal nas/ ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs zhes pa'i bar dang / yum chen khro mo dbang phyug sngo nas/ yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud pas bzhugs/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi gtso bo yab yum bskyed/ shar du lha mo gau rī sngo nas/ g.yon brkyang me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi 'khor rnams bdag bskyed ltar bskyed/ 'on kyang sa bon rnams dor la/ lha mo zhes kun la sbyar ro/ /de nas lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs khar hūm̐ sngon po/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas/ he ru ka lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ yang 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha khro bo rigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ thabs kyi spyod pa sogs sngags dang bcas pas sgrub thabs ltar dbang bskur gtso 'khor thams cad la khro bo rigs lnga re res dbu brgyan/ de nas mchod pa rnams byin rlabs bsdus pa phur pa bzhin byas la/ sgeg phreng sogs kyis phyi mchod/ rang byung gdod nas sngags dang bcas pas nang mchod/ rtog med spros bral sogs sngags dang bcas pas/ de kho na nyid kyis mchod pa/ hūm̐ bde gshegs mnyam nyid nas/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces pa'i bar gyi bstod pa rnams bdag bskyed ltar byas nas/ lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas spos bzung / g.yon dril bu bsil zhing / ngag tu/ hūm̐ he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /nas/ /thugs rjes dgongs nas gnang bar mdzod/ /ces pa'i bar kye rdor bzhin lan gsum brjod/ he zhes bya ba'i tshab tu he ru ka yi tsam 'don pa sgyur/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi sogs nas/ las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ zhes pa'i bar sa lha bzhin brjod pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dges nas rig pa 'dzin pa khyod gzhan don rgya che bar gyis shig ces brjod cing lhas gnang ba byin bar bsam mo/

/de nas bum pa sta gon ni/ bum pa gnyis 'khyil pas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi steng du/ bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma/ zla ba/ drag po pho mo'i gdan/ 'dab ma brgyad la nyi ma dang ro'i gdan re re/ las kyi bum par pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du/ dbus su hūm̐/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du/ gaṃ tsaṃ praṃ baṃ paṃ ghaṃ shaṃ tsaṃ/ hūm̐ ljang sngon rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su dpal chen khro bo'i rgyal nas/ ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /zhes pa'i bar dang / de'i pang na/ yum chen khro mo dbang phyug sngo nas/ yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud pas bzhugs kyi bar dang / shar du lha mo nas/ g.yon brkyang me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /zhes pa'i bar rnams lha sta gon bzhin dang / las kyi bum par/ 'khyil pa dkar dmar dbus ljang zhal/ /rtsa phyag rdo rje thod khrag dang / /bar pas rgya gram be con rnams/ /tha mas phur bsgril yum la 'khyud/ /lha mo rdo rje sgra mdzad ljang / /zhal gcig phyag g.yas dril bu bsnams/ /g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stob/ /brkyang bskum gar gyi gnyis med sbyor/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs khar hūm̐ sngon po zhes pas/ gnas gsum byin brlab/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas he ru ka lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhe+es pas ye shes pa bkug thabs kyi spyod pa sogs kyis dbang bskur te rigs bdag gis rgyas 'debs dang /

sgeg phreng sogs kyi phyi mchod nang mchod rnams lha sta gon bzhin byas la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ bde gshegs mnyam nyid nas/ lha mo rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod ces pa'i bar dang / 'khor ba'i nyon mongs dug dang 'dra ba la/ /ye shes bdud rtsi sman gyi rtsi gtong zhing / /thugs rjes kun la khyab pa'i dbyings su 'khyil/ /khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces bstod la/ pad skor gyis gzungs thag blangs nas/ rang gi snying kha nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten te song ba'i lha rnams kyi brgyud bskul/ sku lus la bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur zhes brjod cing bsam la/ ru lu dang / kro dhi shwa ri sogs lha dgu'i sngags ci rigs pa dang / oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta sogs 'khyil pa'i sngags ji ltar rigs pa bzlas te gong bzhin mchod bstod byas nas/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang / ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis lhag chad kha bskang la/ de nas dung chos kyi chu bum nang du blug cing / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum nang gi lha rnams rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu nas/ bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can du gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ de nas bsrung ma'i gtor ma 'bul dgos rnams 'dir phul nas/ tshogs byin gyis brlabs la/ phud dbul zhing longs spyad/ tshogs lhag rnams bsdus la logs shig tu bsags/ dkyil 'khor gyi mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ byin rlabs bsdus pa/ sgeg phreng gi phyi mchod/ rang byung gi nang mchod/ bde gshegs mnyam nyid sogs kyi bstod pa rnams lha sta gon bzhin byas nas/ ye shes lnga ldan gyis dngos grub blangs/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang / ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya dang / hūm̐ badz+ra ut+tiṣ+ṭhaḥ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor pa rnams/

sang spyan ma drangs kyi bar la nam mkhar bzhugs nas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ sgeg phreng sogs gong bzhin mchod bstod byas nas/ mdun gyi gtor mgron rnams gshegs gsol brtan bzhugs skabs thob dang bstun la bya/ de nas bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i sogs sngags dang bcas pas lus bsrungs/ rang gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de nas bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rnams sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi las thig ni kye rdor bzhin la/ dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad mi bya ba/ rdo rje'i gdung bzhi'i lte ba le dgur bcad pa la/ zla gam dgu bris la/ nyi gdan gyi steng du sku mdog dang mthun pa'i tshom bu dgu 'god pa mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len bzhin yin la/ 'di'i mtshams su/ thig tshon byin rlabs/ ye thig dang / tshon bkra brtag pa sogs phur pa bzhin te/ nub dang po'i cho ga bstan zin to// ༈ /bla mas dbang ldan rtsig pa bri ba sogs tshon skye ba'i rim pa phyag len bzhin 'grub na/ mthar phyi mchod sgos mchod rnams sta gon las mi nyung ba bsham pa sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rnams phyag len bzhin bshams/ thig tshon lhag ma rnams la mchod pa mdor bsdus phul la/ ye shes pa rnams sta gon gyi lha'i thugs khar thim/ zhes dang / nam mkhar bteg pa'i ye shes kyi thig rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la thim zhes brjod cing bsam/ de nas spos dang rol mos sngon du 'gro bas/ slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal dang / las kyi rdo rjes las bum bzung la/ dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum byas/ slob dpon gyis ru lu bzla zhing / mthar lha rnams kyi gnas su bum pa 'bul ba'i steng kha re byed cing / rang gi spyi bor yang gtugs te/ bcom……'di slob dpon kho nas brjod rgyu yin pa nas ser rgyab pa yin ldan 'das dpal he ru ka lha dgus bdag dang sems can thams cad la dbang bskur du gsol/

zhes brjod la dkyil 'khor gyi shar du bum gdan la bzhag yang slob dpon gyis las bum bzung la/ 'khyil sngags brjod cing / lha gnas rnams su 'bul tshul byas pa'i mthar/ 'di yang slob dpon kho nas brjod rgyu yin pa nas ser rgyab pa yin/……khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pas dkyil 'khor gyis bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du/ bar chad thams cad las bsrung du gsol/ zhes brjod la/ byang shar du bum gdan la bzhag cing / slar rol mo dang bcas bzhin pas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba gsum byed cing yig brgya brjod/ mthar shar phyogs su 'brengs te/ ma 'byor ba dang nas/ khyad par du yang dkyil 'khor bri ba la skyon du gyur pa ci mchis pa de dag thams cad bzod par mdzad nas lhag chad kha bskang bar mdzad du gsol gyi bar brjod de/ bum pa dbul ba'o/ /nub gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni dpon slob rnams gral la 'khod nas/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ rnga bying dbab rnams sta gon bzhin byas rjes/ skyabs 'gro nas bzung ste/ lha bskyed pa'i tshe/ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi hūm̐ sngon po de dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du babs pa las s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa sogs nas/ ru lu brjod pa'i bar byas la/ dbus su bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal/ /sogs kyis bdag mdun tha mi dad chen po'i tshul gyis bzlas la bsdu pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin nyams su blang la/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las bye ba'i gtso bo gnyis par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ de nas sgrub khang gi phyi rol du phyogs skyong la phyi rol gtor ma phur pa bzhin btang / kī la ya'i tshab tu/ ru lu brjod/ nongs pa bzod gsol sogs spyi dang 'dra'o/ /slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba ni/ slob dpon gyi mdun du maṇ+ḍal sogs dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad 'dus byas nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rang gi dbang bskur thob pa'i slob dpon du mos la/

las bum gyi chu 'thung zhing / ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus byas/ 'jug pa'i yon du maṇ+ḍal bdun ma phul zhing / sangs rgyas kun dngos bde ba'i mchog /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i gar mdzad pa/ /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /skal bzang lha mo'i tshogs bcas pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /lan gsum gyi gsol ba btab/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /sogs dang / bde gshegs rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas/ /sogs lan gsum re phur ba bzhin brjod/ oṃ tsak+ṣu ban+dha ba rā ma na ya hūm̐ gis gdong bcing / a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis me tog lag tu blang / mdun bskyed kyi thugs kha nas khro bo bdud rtsi'i 'khyil pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ dbang len pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad ces dang / 'khyil sngags brjod/ las bum gyi chus rang la gtor/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ /skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ /de yis bu la ci zhig bya/ /sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /zhes dri ba dris lan brjod/ rang gi snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa ta ya mi/ oṃ su ra ti sa ma ya satwaṃ/ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod cing snying khar rdo rje reg gsang bar gdams pa ni/ rdo rje spyi bor reg cing / deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang sogs kye rdor bzhin dang / hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing / dkyil 'khor gyi sgo nas 'jug par bsam/ dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa la/ sngon 'gro dam bzhag bzhi'i dang po spyi bor rdo rje reg la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dkyil 'khor mchog

/dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas 'dir/ /ma zhugs dad pa med rnams la/ /nam yang smra bar ma byed cig /gal te smras par gyur na ni/ /dngos grub nyams par 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes dang / gnyis pa nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ snying khar rdo rje reg la/ rgyal ba kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /dam tshig 'di las gang 'das pa/ /khrag 'thung 'bar ba'i tshogs bcas kyi/ khros nas snying khrag thod par 'thungs/ /zhes dang / gsum pa gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rnam rgyal bum chu 'thungs la/ 'di khyod rdo rje'i dam tshig yin/ /ma bsrung dmyal bar sreg byed cing / /bsrung na dngos grub thob 'gyur ba'i/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi chu 'thungs shig /pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥ bzhi pa bla ma'i bka' mnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje reg la/ deng phyin chad bu khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyi/ sogs kye rdor bzhin brjod/ dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa la/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung cig sogs bsdus pa phul/ kye rdor bzhin gsol btab lan gsum/ rang skad cig gi he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sku can du gsal ba'i rkang pa gnyis bgrad pa'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sogs 'byung bzhi bskyed pa nas/ sngags dang bcas pa'i bar kye rdor bzhin rol mo dang bcas pa byed/ de nas rang gi spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram mnan la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra brjod cing brtan par bsam/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho zhes pas me tog 'bul ba'i stang kha dang / oṃ pra ti grih+na twaṃ ma hā ba la/ zhes brjod cing me tog mgo la bzhag mig ras bsal bar bsam ste/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi sogs sngags dang bcas pa kye rdor bzhin/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos sogs/ blta par bskul ba phur pa bzhin brjod nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor rnams mthong bar bsam pa ste/ 'jug pa'o// //dngos gzhi slob ma'i dbang la maṇ+ḍal bsdus pa phul/

khyod ni he ru ka dpal te/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi bde stsol mdzad/ /byang chub sems dpa' che rnams kyi/ /yang dag don mchog rnam dag pa/ /ji ltar de nyid bdud rtsi yis/ /dbang gi mchog ni bskur ba bzhin/ /de bzhin bdag la 'khor ba yi/ /sdug bsngal rnams ni sel bar mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdud rtsi dri ma med/ /ma rig pa yi rab rib 'joms/ /gang gi byang chub bla na med/ /de ring bdag gis thob par mdzod/ /lan gsum/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ rang nyid mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma nyi ma'i steng du rang gi sems nyid hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang skad cig gi he ru ka sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhal g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ dbus mthing nag phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang / rnga chung / g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyi thod khrag dang / rgyu zhags 'dzin zhing / yum khro mo dbang phyug ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs khar hūm̐ sngon po/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad he ru ka yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bdag la gnyis su med par thim/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kha nas khro bo dang khro mo dpag tu med pa spros/ dbang len pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad/ rol mo bya zhing / a mṛ ta brjod/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes rnam rgyal bum pa bteg slob dpon gyis dril bu sil zhing me tog gtor la/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi sogs sh+lau ka gsum brjod/ kro dha a mṛ ta dang las bum gyi chu ku shas rang dang dbang rdzas la gtor nas bsang ba 'og ma rnams la'ang 'gre/

swa bhā was sbyangs/ bdag gi rnam shes kyi phung po dang / dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu gnyis mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu gnyis ka badz+ra he ru ka sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hām̐/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad badz+ra he ru ka yab yum gyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bdag dang dbang rdzas lhar bskyed pa la thim/ slar yang / thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha khro bo rigs lnga yab yum 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las badz+ra he ru ka yab yum gyis dbu brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi badz+ra he ru ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes pas gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyi rnam rgyal bum pa bzung ste dbyangs dang bcas pas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi bum pa'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /bum pa'i bdud rtsis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur zhes pa nas/ dbu brgyan zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin brjod/ rnam rgyal bum pa spyi bor reg cing / bum chu 'thung / puṣ+pe sogs mchod pa lngas mchod/

de ltar na badz+ra he ru ka'i sgo nas chus mngon par dbang bskur ba thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ badz+ra he ru ka'i bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes rtogs pa skyed/ cod paṇa gyi dbang la a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ bdag gi tshor ba'i phung po dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du āṃ las rin po che āṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros sogs kun la 'gre/ rat+na he ru ka ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo gri thod 'dzin pa sogs dang / gnas gsum byin brlab/ ye shes pa gzhug pa/ dbang gi lha la gsol ba btab pa sogs nas/ dbang lha zhu ste/ dbang rdzas dbu rgyan du gyur pa/ dbang gi don du gsol ba btab pa rnams gong bzhin byas la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi cod paṇa dbang / /de ring༞ sangs rgyas༞ rin chen cod paṇa dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes brjod la dbu rgyan mgo la bcings/ ku sha'i rtsa bas rnam rgyal bum chu rang gi spyi bor gtor zhing / oṃ badz+ri bhā wa sogs nas/ rat+na he ru kas dbu brgyan zhes pa'i bar dang / mchod pa lngas mchod pa gong bzhin/ de ltar na rat+na he ru ka'i sgo nas cod paṇa gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna'i dri ma dag tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rat+na he ru ka'i bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ rdo rje'i dbang la bsang sbyangs/ bdag gi 'du shes kyi phung po dang / dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du/ dz+rīṃ las pad+ma dz+rīṃ gis mtshan pa sogs 'gre/ pad+ma he ru ka dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/

yum pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa sogs dang / gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes pa gzhug pa/ dbang gi lha la gsol ba btab pa/ dbang lha zhu nas dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur pa/ dbang gi don du gsol ba btab pa rnams gong bzhin byas la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring༞ sangs rgyas༞ rdo rje'i dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes brjod la/ rang gi lag pa g.yas kyi rdo rje gsor/ gong bzhin bum chus dbang bskur te/ pad+ma he ru kas dbu brgyan pa dang / mchod pas mchod pa sogs byed/ de ltar na pad+ma he ru ka'i sgo nas rdo rje'i mngon par dbang bskur ba thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ pad+ma he ru ka'i bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ dril bu'i dbang la/ bsang sbyangs/ bdag gi 'du byed kyi phung po dang / dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa sogs/ karma he ru ka ljang gu ral gri dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu gri thod 'dzin pa sogs dang / gnas gsum byin brlab/ ye shes pa gzhug pa/ dbang gi lha la gsol ba btab pa/ dbang lha zhu nas dbang rdzas dril bur gyur la/ dbang gi don du gsol ba btab pa rnams gong bzhin/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu'i dbang / /de ring༞ sangs rgyas༞ dril bu'i dbang ni sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod la/ rang gi lag pa g.yon gyis dril bu dkrol/ gong bzhin bum pa'i chus dbang bskur te/ karma he ru kas dbu brgyan pa dang / mchod pas mchod pa sogs byed/ de ltar na karma he ru ka'i sgo nas dril bu'i mngon par dbang bskur ba thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/

karma he ru ka'i bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ ming gi dbang la/ bsang sbyangs/ bdag gi gzugs kyi phung po mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du/ bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan pa sogs/ bud+dha he ru ka dkar po 'khor lo dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa sogs dang / gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes pa gzhug pa/ dbang gi don du gsol ba btab pa gong bzhin/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ming gi dbang / /de ring༞ sangs rgyas༞ /rdo rje'i ming gis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta kye zhes dang / rang gi gsang mtshan brjod la/ zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes brjod/ gong bzhin bum chus dbang bskur te bud+dha he ru kas dbu brgyan pa dang / mchod pas mchod pa sogs byed/ de ltar na bud+dha he ru ka'i sgo nas ming gi mngon par dbang bskur ba thob/ gti mug dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ bud+dha he ru ka'i bag chags dang / sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ brtul zhugs la/ rang nyid bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lag pa g.yas pas rdo rje blang la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sogs kye rdor bzhin sngags dang bcas pa brjod/

rdo rje gsor te snying khar reg rang gi snying kha'i nang du yang rdo rje sems dpa' rang 'dra ba mtshon gang ba zhig gis rgyas btab par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ bum chus dbang bskur te/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan zhes sogs brjod/ 'on kyang bum chu 'thor tshul tsam las dngos su mi 'thor/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal bsdus pa phul/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur ba/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /slob dpon go 'phangs rab bsgrub pa'i/ /dbang bskur chen po bdag la stsol/ /lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dbang stegs seṅge bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ rang nyid he ru ka'i skur gsal bar gyur/ zhes dang / rdo rje blangs te/ 'di de sogs brtul zhugs ltar brjod cing / rdo rje thugs khar bzung nas/ thog mtha' med pa'i sogs sngags dang bcas pa dang lag g.yon dril bu dkrol zhing / 'di ni rnal 'byor ma sogs brjod cing / dril bu dku g.yon par kha gyen du bstan te bzung nas/ āḥsrid pa ngo bo sogs sngags dang bcas pa rnams kye rdor bzhin brjod/ de nas rang nyid bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dbang stegs kyi steng du hūm̐ las rang skad cig gi he ru ka sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa sogs/ yum dang bcas pa gong bzhin bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa bcug rdo rje dril bu thugs khar bsnol la/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ /sogs dang / rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /sogs kye rdor ltar brjod/ bum chu spyi bor gtor shing / dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la/ /sogs sngags dang bcas pas dbang bskur te/ khro bo rigs lngas dbu brgyan zhes pa'i bar phur pa bzhin dang / dbang gi lha rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la gnyis su med par thim zhes dang / su pra tiṣ+ṭha brjod cing me tog spyi bor gtor/ puṣ+pe sogs mchod pa lngas mchod/

de ltar khyed la rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dbang bskur ba 'dis/ sogs nas/ do zhal phyed pa nyid du brjod/ ces pa'i bar kye rdor bzhin/ dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid brjod/ lha'i de kho na nyid ni/ dbus kyi he ru ka yab yum ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ gau rī ni me long lta bu'i ye shes/ tsau rī ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ pra mo ha ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ bet+ta lī ni bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes/ puk+ka sī ni sa rnam par dag pa/ ghasma rī ni chu rnam par dag pa/ sh+ma sha na ni me rnam par dag pa/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī ni rlung rnam par dag pa/ dur khrod brgyad ni rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad dag pa/ srung ba'i 'khor lo ni bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon pa'o/ /zhes brjod/ de nas phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /lha mchod pa'i rjes su gnang ba/ ji ltar mig mkhan sogs/ sems can don byed kyi rjes su gnang ba/ sems can kun la thams cad du/ sogs rigs lnga'i sprul bshad kyis rjes su gnang ba sogs kye rdor bzhin brjod nas/ de ltar na khyod kyis bskyed pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs te mthong / bum pa'i dbang thob/ gtso bor lus kyi dri ma dag dam tshig rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig bsrung ba dang / lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /gsang dbang la maṇ+ḍal bsdus pa phul/ gsol ba btab nas/ nga rgyal bzung ba'i bar phur pa bzhin la/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i tshab tu/ he ru ka dpal bdag nyid do/ /zhes brjod/ de nas 'bru gsum brjod cing mig ras bkrol bar bsam la/ de ltar na yum gyi bha ga nas gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gtso bor ngag gi dri ma dag dam tshig sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i ril bu bsten pa dang / laṃ tsaṇ+ḍa lī bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/

/de nas lung bstan yang phur pa bzhin la/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang / /zhes pa'i tshab tu/ bcom ldan he ru ka dpal dang / /zhes brjod cing / dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod gnyis kyang phur pa bzhin no/ /shes rab ye shes la maṇ+ḍal bsdus pa phul/ gsol ba btab la/ gdong g.yogs bkrol ba'i bar phur pa bzhin la/ nyams myong dga' ba bzhi bskyed pa'i dus su/ rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi tshab/ rang he ru ka dang / rig ma khro mo dbang phyug mar gsal ba'i zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ rtogs pa bskyed pa ni/ de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ gtso bor sems kyi dri ma dag dam tshig bud med la mi smod pa dang / lam pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu chos sku'i bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /de nas dbang bzhi pa la maṇ+ḍal bsdus pa phul/ gsol btab phur pa bzhin/ de nas gdong g.yogs bkrol ba'i bar kye rdor bzhin byas la/ de ltar na khyod kyis don dam pa byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa tshig tsam gyi sgo nas thob/ lus ngag yid gsum char gyi dri ma dag dam tshig dgongs te gsungs pa'i dam tshig bsrung ba dang / lam rdo rje rba rlabs bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /de nas gtso bo'i ji ltar sogs dang / maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba/ bkra shis rnams/ deng nas brtsams te rnams spyi dang 'dra/ bsrung ba'i gtor ma 'bul ba nas/ tshogs bar pa yan dang / bskang gso byas na/ thun gtor 'bul ba/ bkra shis rnams phyag len bzhin dang / de nas mchod pa kha gsos la/ byin rlabs bsdus pa byas nas phyi mchod nang mchod/ bstod pa/ dngos grub blang ba/ bzod par gsol ba rnams sta gon bzhin byas rjes/ rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs dang / bye brag tu yang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid gshegs gsol ma byas kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/

brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes dang / su pra tiṣ+ṭha sogs brjod cing me tog gtor/ rten med pa rnams la gshegs gsol sogs nas/ bkra shis yan sta gon bzhin bya'o/ /nub tha ma la/ tshogs tha ma bsgral ba'i mchod pa dang lhag ma btang la/ bsrung ba'i gtor ma/ sgrub khang gi steng du dbul zhing / bstan ma'i gtor ma yang sgrub thabs bzhin bstan skyong byas rjes 'og tu dpon slob rnams dkyil 'khor gyi mthar bzhengs/ bum dbang gnyis dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo dang / byang shar du bum gdan la bzhag mchod pa kha gso byas rjes/ byin gyis brlab cing 'bul ba nas/ rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs yan song rjes/ rdul tshon gyi ye shes pa dang / bum nang gi lha gtor mgron la byon pa'i rten med pa rnams/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can sogs/ gdangs dang bcas pa tshar gsum gyi mjug tu/ rol mo dang bcas pas/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyis rdo rje'i rtses dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa dang pos shig la/ chos thams cad skye ba med pa yid la dran pas/ ngag tu a kā ro'i sngags brjod/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi me ris nas dbus kyi mtshan ma'i bar rdo rje'i rtses ri mo 'then/ de bzhin du phyogs gzhan rnams la'ang 'then/ sgrub g.yog pa kha cig gis/ rdul tshon mtha' nas rim gyis bsdus te rin po che la sogs pa'i snod du blug pa dang / thig rjes rnams mi mngon par bsubs/ slob dpon gyis bum chu thig rjes la blug go /de nas bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i sogs nas/ bkra shis rgyas par brjod cing / dkyil 'khor bris shul la me tog gi char dbab cing / rol mo'i sgra rgya cher bya'o/ /dngos gzhi dang po'i bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa spyan drangs shing bstim pa'i skabs su/

sta gon gyi ye shes pa nam mkhar bzhugs pa'ang thim par bsam/ dngos gzhi gnyis pa man la/ phyi rol pa song rjes/ bum bskyed mdzad do/ /de rnams kyis yang dag me dgu'i rdul tshon la brten pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod byed tshul ngag 'don rnams gtso bor ston pa yin la/ mchod pa bsham tshul sogs lag len rgyas pa kho bos byas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ras bris la brten pa blo dman dga' ba skyed byed du blta bar bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni sa lo chen po'i dbang bsdus kyi chos chen la sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pas/ lcags lugs chu stod zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes la/ gdan sa lha khang chen mo'i theg chen pho brang du bris pa'o// //shu bha mastu sarba dza ga taṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ yang dag me dgu'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod byed tshul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
